semiconductor_relevance: High — Advanced Dicing Technologies specializes in dicing equipment and processes critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Advanced Dicing Technologies (ADT) is a leading manufacturer of dicing saws and blades used in the semiconductor and microelectronics industries. They provide comprehensive dicing solutions, including equipment with various automation levels and peripheral accessories to meet diverse customer needs.
capabilities: Dicing saw systems for silicon-based ICs
Dicing blades including resin, metal sintered, and nickel
Wafer cleaning and water recycling systems
